## What it is

The housing stood on the desk stand, with the Arduino shell and cover on the back and the baffle in the track. It is a placement check, not a print.

## Design notes

- The housing bolts to the stand on the original four holes. The shell's mating face is the housing backplate. The cover lip points into the bay.
- Nothing in the assembly intersects. The shell clears the stand pillars by 17.6 mm.

## Don't

- Don't export the assembly as one STL. Each part has its own print orientation.
